title: #36 addSettings trap is refused before any tx on chain 97
notes: 0.33.0 write-path guard. proposal_create's Step 3c runs checkAddSettingsTrap on the FINAL actions — including the `custom` branch, which takes caller-supplied actionsOnFor verbatim and never touches PROPOSAL_BUILDERS, so it bypassed the registry guard entirely. The trap is selector-keyed (0x6a11e769 = GovSettings.addSettings), not executor-keyed. Returns mode 'blocked-risky' with risk DANGER and an advisory naming #36; nothing is pinned and nothing is broadcast, so this scenario is free and deterministic. The orchestrator lands it as a SKIPPED step (the refusal cascades to dependants) and the assertions below are what make it a real check.

args.title: Governance settings slot for the grants committee
args.description: Swarm regression — the #36 gate must refuse this before any broadcast.

expect.note: The DANGER gate returns before runFlow, so there is no payload list at all — not an empty one.
